svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: 72 file tools. Most run entirely in your browser, so the file never leaves the device.
Desktop or phone, installable PWA. HTML + CSS + vanilla JS, no framework, no build step.
app.js: tool modal, progress, downloads, routing (/merge-pdf ...)
tools.js: catalogue of all 72 tools · chains.js: "Keep going" + My Recipes
Off the main thread, UI never freezes
Text for Read Aloud and Summarize
Canvas: convert, resize to KB, exam photo
Camera: scan to PDF, QR reader
Compress PDF to Exact Size: server
Browser tools read the file with FileReader and write the result to a Blob download.
No network request ever carries the file. Nothing about your files is stored.
Results can flow straight into the next tool with the "Keep going" bar.
python:3.11-slim · non-root · read-only FS · cap_drop ALL
Feedback: stars + reports as JSONL, no IP, no files
413 above 100 MB · 60 server jobs / IP / hour
Trusted host, CORS, CSP, HSTS, no-store
3 GB memory · 300 s limit · 90 s queue, else 503
A hostile file can only crash its own job
PDF → Word / Excel / PowerPoint, PDF/A, repair
Files live in memory and tmpfs only, deleted when
the job ends. No database, no accounts, no storage.
Python 3.11 (server) · JavaScript ES2020 (browser) · WebAssembly · Docker · AGPL-3.0
